incidents.name: SubQuery Settings unprotected setBatchAddress
incidents.notes: Settings.setBatchAddress()/setContractAddress() lacked the onlyOwner modifier, so the attacker repointed the StakingManager and RewardsDistributor registry entries at their own helper, which then passed Staking's address-based authorization checks and moved the Staking proxy's 218M SQT out via unbondCommission()/withdrawARequest().

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the Settings TransparentUpgradeableProxy created 2024-02-13 by 0x70d0afee4a6a314d71046da9b4bbcfb8fd1722ce (not the attacker); its only pre-incident Upgraded event is the deployment-block one pointing at implementation 0xf282737992da4217bf5f8b6ae621181e84d7d3b9, the flawed Settings code named in the PoC. SubQuery's own report states ~$134,000 USD.
